text:
Clara (Design): folks, uploaded a compact-row prototype for the prompt-evals scorecard. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc987/compact-scorecard?node-id=2%3A4
Clara (Design): intention: let power reviewers zip through regressions with minimal vertical scroll. each row shows one-line prompt, a tiny sparkline, severity pill, and three icon actions (approve, view diff, flag). expand reveals full outputs.
Ravi (Product): makes sense for heavy users. quick q: how do we avoid accidental approves when people try to expand a row?
Clara (Design): plan: separate action icon for approve. row click/Enter toggles expand; approve is an explicit IconButton with its own hit target and small inline confirm.
Jon (Frontend): perf note: we'll use react-window with variable row heights. expanded rows change height; we'll measure via resize observer. also need to ensure icon buttons stopPropagation so they don't open the expander.
Marta (A11y): accessibility checklist: row should be role="listitem" and keyboard focusable. make summary a <button> to get correct semantics. icon actions must be real buttons with aria-labels. ensure color choices meet 3:1 at small sizes.
Theo (UX Research): research insight: users preferred inline accept/undo vs modal. recommend toast with Undo. also add tiny inline confirmation ("Accept this run?") on first click to avoid fat-finger errors on touch.
Clara (Design): noted. change copy: approve -> "Accept output"; badge text: "degraded quality" instead of "regressed".
Jon (Frontend): ci/a11y run from branch feat/compact-row shows failures: 
```naxe: color-contrast (ApproveIcon) - 2.2:1 against white
eslint: jsx-a11y/no-noninteractive-element-interactions in RowSummary
```
Marta (A11y): lower contrast on the green icon; swap to darker green and add visible focus ring. RowSummary must be a button not a div. also add aria-expanded on the row.
Ravi (Product): consider severity filter chips (High/Med/Low) and a keyboard shortcut (Shift+F) to open filters — SRE reviewers requested that.
Clara (Design): adding filter chips in the top sticky toolbar. will wire shortcuts in spec.
Jon (Frontend): code sketch: 
```jsx
// pseudo
<List role=\"list\">
  <Row role=\"listitem\">
    <SummaryButton aria-expanded={expanded}/>
    <IconButton aria-label=\"Accept output\" onClick={handleAccept}/>
    <Expander hidden={!expanded}><DiffPreview/></Expander>
  </Row>
</List>
```
Jon (Frontend): will also add live region announcements: "Run accepted. Undo" and make toast keyboard-focusable.
Marta (A11y): use role=\\"status\\" for non-critical confirmations. for the undo action, ensure it's reachable via Tab and has accessible name. include contextual SR text like "Run 123 accepted. Undo".
Theo (UX Research): adding a tiny directional indicator (chevron up/down + percentage) was helpful in tests; don't rely on color alone. include aria-label like "quality decreased by 4%".
Clara (Design): will add chevrons and textual tooltip. also preparing a compact + expanded variant in figma.
Jon (Frontend): I can fix the lint/axe issues by swapping the icon color and replacing non-button summary with a button. will send a 20s screen recording showing keyboard nav in the PR.
ci-bot: note: please add an axe baseline for /evals routes in CI to catch regressions.
Ravi (Product): love it. track follow-ups: (1) add Undo toast spec, (2) keyboard shortcut for filters, (3) a11y checklist in PR template. leaving thread open for last copy/a11y tweaks. :tada:
